periods.summary: Ein joins Or-Gaule after becoming bored with assassination as paid work and wanting to use lives to bloom beautiful flowers. At Rebellion headquarters she kills seven Apostles by planting magical roses in their bodies, keeping them alive in agony. She later infiltrates the Vermillion palace with Sleep Beauty lilies whose pollen paralyzes everyone except Sirius. She introduces herself as a nameless visitor temporarily called Ein, says she has brought funeral flowers, and explains her uterus-housed seed Device Astaroth. Sirius resists, but she disables him with Thorn Whip and attempts to plant Vampire Queen in his wounds. Yui Tatara, disguised as a maid, blocks the seed and confronts Ein for murdering their family and clients, leading to an assassin duel interrupted by Or-Gaule's announcement.

periods.summary: Ein is offscreen for much of the volume but remains a major threat. During the Caldia truce Or-Gaule sends her a thread-borne order to retreat from her palace attack, and she leaves while mocking Yui Tatara for wasting her chance by saving Sirius. Later Lunaeyes lists her as one of Quedland's five representatives. Tatara explains that Ein betrayed Up Grund, killed the assassin family, and even attacked clients, making her a professional disgrace Tatara must personally erase. Stella promises not to interfere with Tatara's chosen quarry.

periods.summary: Ein waits in Luxel castle's rose garden with tea and invites Yui Tatara to become her true sister. When Yui attacks, Ein uses magical plants: Trigger Happy tulips fire seed bullets, Bamboo Javelin traps movement, and Crunch Alligator attempts to crush Yui. After losing her left arm, Ein reveals bramble techniques that combine slow pressure with sudden whip strikes, exactly targeting the weakness of Yui's impact-timed reflection. She captures Yui, twists her limbs, drives thorns into her body and mouth, and tries to continue the torture while justifying it to the broadcaster as necessary against reflection. Yui's Damage Reflect reverses all injuries onto Ein, but Ein responds by calling Astaroth and blooming the Netherworld World Tree from her body. The World Tree contaminates the rose garden, turns ordinary plants into magical beasts, multiplies when cut, and grows strong enough to push through Total Reflect. Ein mocks Yui's effort and believes no reflection technique can hurt such a huge rooted body. In the past, Ein was the top House of Darkness sister who gave Fia chocolate, taught her to find a reason to live, and later admitted that her talent was creating a new conscience-free personality suited to killing. In the present, Yui reaches the root, thanks the old Ein, and uses Astral Force; the white impact destroys the castle and World Tree, apparently ending Ein before she can counterattack.

key_events.summary: Tortures Yui, suffers Damage Reflect, and reveals the Netherworld World Tree.
